correctness.rationale: In V=C e_- ⊕ W ⊕ C e_+, the quadratic form restricted to span(e_-,u,e_+,v) is 2ac+2 B(u,v)bd. Its symmetric matrix determinant is B(u,v)^2, independently rechecked symbolically; smooth rank-4 section iff nonorthogonal, whereas B(u,v)=0 makes ac=0, two planes meeting in m=P<span(u,v)>. For distinct orthogonal isotropic u,v, span(e_-+tv,u) and span(v,u+se_+) are isotropic one-parameter line families joining the extremal endpoint lines via m. The source Corollary 2.7 places the reduced chain in the quotient. Any off-diagonal reducible chain must have the unique m through u,v; source Theorem 3.12 establishes irreducible boundary E, and the incidence divisor I is irreducible. Hence E→I birational. Diagonal exceptional scheme not classified.
